title: Widget families through one factory
purpose: Show toolkit depends on abstract factory/products; concrete factories create consistent families.
alt: 추상 WidgetFactory에 의존하는 툴킷과 WinXP·Motif의 TextBox·ScrollBar 제품군
requiredChecks: UIToolKit uses only WidgetFactory, TextBox and ScrollBar abstractions; no client→concrete product creation.
WidgetFactory declares createTextBox(): TextBox and createScrollBar(): ScrollBar.
WinXPWidgetFactory and MotifWidgetFactory implement WidgetFactory; each creates its matching TextBox/ScrollBar family.
WinXPTextBox/MotifTextBox implement TextBox; WinXPScrollBar/MotifScrollBar implement ScrollBar; no cross-family creation.
prompt: Create a NEW original English raster technical diagram for a design-pattern study blog. White background, navy large sans-serif labels, flat blue and teal cards, spacious connectors, no copied slide layout or logos. Monospaced class/method identifiers. Distinguish uses, implements and creates via labels on directional connectors. Title "Widget families through one factory". TOP: UIToolKit→WidgetFactory labelled uses. WidgetFactory lists createTextBox(): TextBox and createScrollBar(): ScrollBar. Top-right "Product interfaces: TextBox, ScrollBar"; UIToolKit→this card "uses returned products". BELOW TWO panels. WinXP panel: WinXPWidgetFactory upward arrow toWidgetFactory labelled implements, downward creates branch to WinXPTextBox caption implements TextBox and WinXPScrollBar caption implements ScrollBar. Motif panel: MotifWidgetFactory implements WidgetFactory; creates MotifTextBox caption implements TextBox and MotifScrollBar caption implements ScrollBar. No client→concrete classes or cross-family creates links. Footer "Inject a factory; the toolkit uses abstract products". Large clean gutters, no unlabeled UML triangles.
